This "many small, some medium, few huge" pattern is the signature of a power law. The "bursts within bursts" you feel is this exact pattern playing out in time: many very short pauses, some medium pauses, and a few very, very long pauses.

### A Toy Process That Makes Bursts: "The Copycat Waiter"

Here is a toy process that naturally creates this power-law behavior.

Imagine you're keeping a list of "wait times" that have happened so far. To decide your next wait time, you follow a simple rule:
